app_name: Valence Institute & Academy Student Management System

theme_strategy.mode: light and dark with executive navy accent

components_specification.sidebar: Fixed two-column navigation with deep blue background (#0A1128), collapsible items, badges for unread tasks/walk-ins, role switcher (Admin, Trainer, Student)
components_specification.header: Sticky glassmorphism header with global search, notifications popover, quick add modal trigger, and user profile avatar
components_specification.dashboard_kpis: 4 executive overview cards with sparklines, percentage changes, and icon badges
components_specification.revenue_chart: Responsive vertical bar/line chart with 12M / 6M / 30D timeframe filter controls
components_specification.tables: Searchable, sortable, filterable tables with pagination and action menus for students, walk-ins, and batches
components_specification.modals_offcanvas: Drawer and dialog components for Walk-in capture, Student registration, Admission & Fee tracking, and Batch allocation
components_specification.student_profile: Comprehensive multi-tab profile (Overview, Attendance, Fee Ledger, Performance, Video Records, Reports)

accessibility_requirements.apca_contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text
accessibility_requirements.interactive_states: Explicit hover:text-white and focus:ring-2 on all buttons and inputs
accessibility_requirements.data_testid: Mandatory on all interactive buttons, links, form fields, and status badges

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals without proper blur or solid backing
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes
Maintain high contrast and clean spacing throughout the dashboard
